Zero. Nada. Zilch. That's how many HOT setups we're seeing, and you gotta be kidding me if you're surprised. The tape’s been drifting, the major indexes chopping sideways, and volatility? Barely a pulse. Look, it's not a crime for the market to take a breather, but the absence of any real squeezes here? That’s the market *screaming* neutrality at us, and we’d be fools not to listen. Risk is off for now, folks. Full stop.

When everything’s neutral, there’s no edge in forcing trades. The broader market is in “wait-and-see” mode, and so are we. No HOT tickers out of zero names tracked means there’s no fuel for those explosive breakouts we thrive on. That doesn’t mean the market’s breaking down; it just means the engines are idling. The big players aren’t making bold moves, which tells me they’re waiting for a signal—Fed chatter, earnings fireworks, sector leadership, something. Until then, we’re dancing in place.

But here’s the thing: even in the quiet, the market leaves breadcrumbs. Our portfolio is loaded with small, explosive names still running their races. Take $NIO, for example. It’s up 39% since our entry, and if you’re not already in, here’s your cheat code: get involved or get left behind. Same with $IOVA, up a juicy 72%. That’s leadership. And $MRNA? Let’s just say selling half at 2x wasn’t luck—it’s discipline. The biotech names have quietly been some of the strongest swimmers in this neutral tide. Are you noticing the rotation? The market is telling us something. Are we listening?

Meanwhile, the Energy patch is waking up. $OXY is steady at an 11% gain, but $APA is still flat. These two are your barometers for what happens next in the sector. If crude rips higher, these names are going to follow, probably faster than you can hit “buy.” Similar story with $UUUU and $NNE in uranium. These nuclear plays are holding steady, which, while not thrilling, is constructive. Stability is a launchpad.

What about late entries? If you’re itching to put cash to work, keep an eye on names like $GRPN and $ERO. Groupon is up 82%, and industrial metals are always a sneaky tell on the global growth story. These setups are still actionable, but size your positions smart. This isn’t the time to go all-in.

Today, my eyes are on biotech for follow-through, Energy for signs of life, and whatever breadcrumbs the major indexes leave behind. Don’t expect fireworks, but don’t sleep either. The market’s quiet now, but when this powder keg finally lights, it’s gonna be epic. And the bears? They’ve got nothing.
